errors.apply.store: Boba could not read that application. Try again.
errors.apply.unknown_application: That application is no longer in the Tracker.
errors.apply.unknown_offer: The Offer this application points to is gone.
errors.apply.invalid_id: That application id does not look right.
errors.apply.export_path: Boba could not find a folder for the kit.
errors.apply.export_write: Boba could not write the PDFs. Check the disk and try again.
errors.apply.not_ready: Some documents are not verified yet. Open the Studio, fix the checks and render them before applying.
errors.apply.no_email_channel: This posting has no apply address, so there is no email to send.
errors.apply.already_sent: This application was already sent. Boba never sends the same application twice.
errors.apply.needs_check: An earlier send never reported back. Check your Sent folder before sending again.
errors.apply.confirm_resend: An earlier send may have gone through. Confirm before sending it again.
errors.apply.empty_subject: Give the email a subject first.
errors.apply.send_unreachable: Your mail provider could not be reached, so the email was not sent. Check your connection and try again.
errors.apply.send_rejected: Your mail provider refused the message. Check the address and your account, then try again.
errors.apply.reauthorize: Your mail connection needs to be authorised again. Reconnect it and try again.
errors.apply.unknown_account: Choose a connected mailbox to send from.
errors.apply.ats_not_a_form: This Offer has no form Boba can fill.
errors.apply.ats_opt_in: Turn on form filling first — Boba only opens your browser after you accept the warning.
errors.apply.ats_unknown_attempt: That submission is no longer waiting for a check.
errors.apply.ats_unknown_answer: That answer is no longer in the bank.
errors.apply.ats_answer_edit: That edited answer cannot be saved. Keep it short and non-empty.
errors.apply.ats_browser: Boba could not drive the browser. Check that Chrome or Chromium is installed and try again.
errors.apply.rule_invalid: That rule has a value out of range. Check the caps, the thresholds and the active hours.
errors.apply.settings_invalid: That Apply setting is out of range.
errors.apply.rule_unconfirmed: Turn Auto on through the confirmation dialog first.
errors.apply.rule_missing: Add at least one enabled rule before turning Auto on.
errors.apply.rule_clock: Boba cannot read its own clock, so it cannot decide this now.
errors.apply.outbox_hold: The Outbox hold must be between 5 minutes and 24 hours.
errors.apply.outbox_dry_run: A dry run reports between 1 and 10 matches.
errors.apply.outbox_not_found: That item is no longer in the Outbox.
errors.apply.outbox_not_live: That item already left the Outbox, so it cannot be changed.
errors.apply.outbox_edit: That edit cannot be saved. Keep it short and non-empty.
errors.apply.outbox_clock: Boba cannot read its own clock, so it cannot time this hold.
errors.apply.outbox_queued: This application is already waiting in the Outbox.
errors.apply.outbox_kill_switch: The Kill Switch is on, so Boba is not sending anything automatically.
errors.apply.kill_switch: Boba could not read or change the Kill Switch.
errors.apply.session_not_board: This posting's source is not a Session Board Boba can fill.
errors.apply.session_opt_in: Turn on this Session Board first — Boba only fills its forms after you accept the account-ban warning.
errors.apply.session_paused: This Session Board is paused after a challenge. Open Connections, resolve it and resume the source.
errors.apply.session_off_board: That apply link does not point at the job board, so Boba will not open your signed-in session there.
errors.apply.session_unknown_attempt: That Session Board attempt is no longer waiting.
errors.apply.session_kill_switch: The Kill Switch is on, so Boba is not filling any form.
errors.apply.session_browser: Boba could not drive your browser session. Check that Chrome or Chromium is installed and try again.
errors.apply.session_cap_reached: This Session Board has used today's page budget. Try again tomorrow, or raise its limit in Connections.
